title: IrisDESCENT
description: A very cool shader about making minecraft even more beautiful
body:
# IrisDescent

**IrisDescent** is a stylized, non-realistic shader pack for Minecraft: Java Edition, 
built exclusively for the [Iris](https://irisshaders.dev/) shader loader.

---

## Visual Style

IrisDescent is not a realistic shader. It is a **stylized, high-contrast, 
atmospheric** shader inspired by dark fantasy aesthetics and anime color grading.


If you want your world to look cooler, and similar to vanilla, without loosing too much fps — 
IrisDescent is for you.

---

## Features

- **Stylized lighting** — semi-toon shading with quantized light bands, giving 
  terrain a painted, graphic quality rather than a smooth photorealistic gradient
- **Iridescent water** — dark, reflective water surface with animated normals 
  and vivid underwater color
- **Custom sky gradient** — dawn and dusk render warm amber-to-violet gradients; 
  noon is a deep saturated blue rather than vanilla pale blue
- **Color grading** — Vanilla
- **PCF soft shadows** — 2048x shadow map with softened edges

---

## Compatibility

| | |
|---|---|
| **Loader** | Iris 1.7+ (Fabric / NeoForge) |
| **Minecraft** | 1.21.1 Java Edition (tested), should work on 1.20.1+ |
| **OptiFine** | ✅ Compatible |
| **Sodium** | ✅ Compatible (required by Iris) |
| **GPU** | Any GPU capable of running Iris shaders |

---

## Installation

1. Install [Iris](https://irisshaders.dev/) (includes Sodium automatically)
2. Launch Minecraft and go to **Options → Video Settings → Shader Packs**
3. Drop the `IrisDescent.zip` into the shaderpacks folder
4. Select IrisDescent in the list and click **Apply**

---

## Early Release

This is an early release. Some visuals may be rough around the edges — 
if you encounter issues or have feedback, feel free to open a report 
in the Issues tab.
